svg.aria-label: Figure 2. Official major categories × data-driven communities
svg.style: font-family:'IBM Plex Sans KR','Apple SD Gothic Neo','Noto Sans KR',sans-serif;background:#FFFFFF
svg.text: Figure 2. Official major categories (rows) × Louvain communities of the shared-KSA graph (columns) — each row is that category's distribution over communities
Cell = share (%) of the category's occupations in that community. The more a row concentrates in one column, the better the official category and the data agree.
